profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. According to its own website, it describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV) technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. The site says EHang provides AAV products and commercial solutions across urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions, and describes itself as a forerunner in the global Urban Air Mobility industry.

The site lists product and solution areas including passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions. It also maintains sections for company news, media coverage, video, partners, investor relations, and subscriptions.

EHang Holdings Ltd is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001759783. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
